crossRefs.note: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.
But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives.
Ahimaaz called, and said to the king, “All is well.” He bowed himself before the king with his face to the earth, and…
Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you…
Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.
As you enter into the household, greet it.
If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn’t worthy, let your peace return to you.
Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’
Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be…
Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.

translations.web: Tell him, ‘Long life to you! Peace be to you! Peace be to your house! Peace be to all that you have!
translations.bsb: and say to him, ‘Long life to you, and peace to you and to your house and to all that belongs to you.
translations.kjv: And thus shall ye say to him that liveth in prosperity, Peace be both to thee, and peace be to thine house, and peace be unto all that thou hast.
translations.asv: and thus shall ye say to him that liveth in prosperity, Peace be unto thee, and peace be to thy house, and peace be unto all that thou hast.
